title: ROOT: “STAY IN MY LANE!”  England beat Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs  1st Test
quote_text:
Post-match press conference with England captain Joe Root after England beat Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs in the first Test at Headingley.

Root reflects on the performance and his successful return to the captaincy, including England’s tempo with the bat, the fast-bowling unit and the contributions of Jordan Cox and Dan Lawrence.

He also discusses communication with Stephen Fleming, the future of Test cricket at Headingley, Ollie Robinson’s form, adapting to the conditions and World Test Championship over-rate penalties.
